# OMP Oracle

> Extension for the Oh My Pi (OMP) and `pi` coding agents that sends hard, long-running work to
> ChatGPT or Grok through the web app. `/oracle` packs a context-rich archive of the repository,
> hands it with the prompt to the selected provider in an isolated browser session, and returns
> immediately. The answer is saved to disk under `/tmp/oracle-<job-id>/`, and the session that asked
> gets one best-effort wake-up when it arrives. Uses the operator's own ChatGPT or Grok subscription,
> not an API key. Experimental public beta. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the `pi-oracle` maintainer, OpenAI, or xAI.

## Install

- Requires Node.js `>=22.19.0`, Google Chrome or Chromium signed in to ChatGPT or Grok,
  `agent-browser`, `tar`, and `zstd` (for ChatGPT `.tar.zst` archives).
- Oh My Pi: `omp install omp-oracle`. `pi`: `pi install npm:omp-oracle`.
- Forked from `fitchmultz/pi-oracle` and published on npm as `omp-oracle`. `pi-oracle` on npm is the
  upstream package, does not carry this fork's changes, and must be removed first
  (`omp plugin uninstall pi-oracle` or `pi remove npm:pi-oracle`).
- In a normal persisted Oh My Pi or `pi` session (`--no-session` runs report oracle unavailable), run
  `/oracle-auth` once to import cookies for your default provider (`/oracle-auth grok` for Grok),
  then `/oracle <request>`. Inspect or recover missed wake-ups from disk with `/oracle-status` and
  `/oracle-read <job-id>`.

## Boundaries

- Per job, exactly two things leave the machine, under the operator's own account: the prompt and one
  project archive (`.tar.zst` for ChatGPT up to 250 MiB, `.tar.gz` for Grok up to 200 MiB).
- Archive inputs must resolve inside the project without symlink escapes, or the job is rejected
  locally. `.git`, tool state, `secrets/`, `.env*`, keys, and databases are excluded by default
  during directory expansion; explicitly named paths are archived as named. Default exclusions do not
  catch every secret, so pass narrower paths when the whole repository should not leave the machine.
- By default, `/oracle-auth` reads the operator's browser cookies once in read-only mode into an
  isolated seed profile that each job clones; the real browser profile is never automated by default.
  Driving one pinned tab in an existing signed-in Chrome (via loopback CDP relay) or a dedicated
  managed Chrome profile is opt-in for ChatGPT.
- No telemetry and no hosted control plane. A single-operator local tool, not a hosted, multi-user, or
  API-key route.
